Legal approval for Data Processing Agreement required by December 4th.
Technical workshop scheduled for next week; user list for pilot to be sent Monday.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Then I agree. Phase 1 on December 1st without single sign-on, and single sign-on in January. I need it in writing.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: Of course. I'll send you a revised quote and the statement of work with the two phases by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Good. About the budget, we have a hard cap of 80,000 euros for this year. The first quote was 85.

lines.speaker: Lisa
lines.text: I understand. If single sign-on moves to January, part of the cost moves to next year's budget. I'm confident we can stay under 80,000 for this year.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: I have one concern. Our legal team requires that all data stays in the European Union. Where are your servers?

lines.speaker: Alex Martin
lines.text: Our main servers are in Frankfurt, so it's fine. But our backup provider is in the US. I need to check if we can move the backups to Europe. I'll confirm that by next Friday.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Thank you, that's important. If backups stay in the US, legal will block the project.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Also, we want a pilot first. 40 users in the finance team, for two weeks, before the full rollout to the 600 employees.
